row.evidence: GrowthBook's pricing page lists "SSO & SCIM provisioning" only under the Enterprise (Custom, Contact Us) plan, and the SCIM docs say SCIM is available on Enterprise plans and requires SSO.
row.notes: Cloud plans: Starter free (up to 3 users), Pro $40/seat/month (up to 30 users; billing period not stated on the page), Enterprise custom. SSO on Starter/Pro is Google sign-in only; custom OIDC SSO and SCIM are Enterprise. SCIM uses a Secret API key with Admin role as the bearer token; officially supports Okta (via Okta's generic SCIM 2.0 Test App) and Entra ID (non-gallery app). Deprovisioning removes the member from the organization; only growthbookRole can be updated over SCIM (no name or email changes). Self-hosted Enterprise needs a license key. REST API (members, roles, teams) has no plan gate on the pricing table; teams are an Enterprise feature.

operations.notes: Updates are limited to growthbookRole; the HTTP verb is not documented. Deprovisioning removes the member rather than leaving a deactivated user; re-provisioning adds them back with the default role.

custom.how: growthbookRole attribute in the core User namespace (values readonly, collaborator, engineer, analyst, experimenter, admin)

roles.how: growthbookRole attribute sets the global role; groups become Teams; project-level roles not supported

limitations.text: Officially supports only Okta and Microsoft Entra ID.
Only growthbookRole can be updated; user email cannot be changed after provisioning.
Project-level permissions cannot be provisioned via SCIM.

auth.notes: Secret keys (admin or readonly role) or personal access tokens, via HTTP Basic or Bearer.

endpoints.purpose: Remove a user from the organization

audit_log_api.notes: Audit log is exportable in the app (Enterprise per pricing); no audit REST endpoint in the OpenAPI spec.

okta.notes: No OIN app; GrowthBook's guide uses Okta's generic SCIM 2.0 Test App (OAuth Bearer Token).

entra.notes: Guide uses a non-gallery Entra enterprise app.

fallbacks.notes: SSO emailDomains setting allows auto-joining the organization from a verified email domain.
